Rules: sections are `[name]` lines; keys are `key = value` (spaces around `=` optional); lines starting with `#` or `;` are comments, and a ` ;` or ` #` (space then the character) after a value or after a section header starts a trailing comment that is ignored; blank lines are ignored; values may be double- or single-quoted, in which case the quotes are stripped and everything inside is kept verbatim (including spaces and `#`/`;`); unquoted values `true`/`false` in any case become booleans and unquoted values that are valid integers (optional sign, digits) become ints, everything else stays a string; a repeated key keeps the last value; a repeated section merges into the earlier one; keys before any section header go into a section named `DEFAULT`; a line that is not a comment, section or key=value raises ValueError, as does a section header without the closing bracket. Empty input returns {}. --output-format json --dangerously-skip-permissions --max-turns 60 --model sonnet
